newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Jan 30.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Jan 30.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

-------- COMMENTS - Bunkers prices held steady late Thursday with healthy demand seen propping up levels, traders said. A major said he sold a total of 3,000-4,000 tonnes of 380-cst at $99 per tonne and about 1,000 tonnes of 180-cst at $106. "Some majors were quoting higher levels earlier but later lowered their offers to meet buyers' quotes," he said. "It's good that prices are maintaining a certain level of steadiness," he added.
